body.prompt: TEACHER (now): the same boy grown into a young man in his mid-twenties: same round face and short black hair, grey cardigan over a white shirt, a teacher's lanyard with a plain blank card. OLD DOG: the same golden-yellow nureongi now old and big, a grey-white muzzle, slightly cloudy eyes, a faded red collar. UMBRELLA: a child's bright yellow umbrella with one small white heart hand-painted on one panel. Rainy afternoon at the stone school gate, the same composition as an old memory. The teacher crouches and holds the open yellow umbrella with the white heart over the old dog, so the rain falls on his own back now; the old dog leans its grey muzzle against his knee. Only the teacher and the dog in the frame, no magpie. Style: handcrafted 3D miniature diorama photographed with a macro lens, tilt-shift, shallow depth of field, soft cinematic light, felt, clay, paper and wood textures with tiny hand-painted details, gentle film grain, warm nostalgic color grade, clay figurines with soft rounded faces and gentle, restrained, understated expressions (no tears, no crying, no exaggerated sad faces), not photorealistic. Vertical 9:16 frame, main subject in the middle of the frame, a calm uncluttered area in the top fifth of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no hangul, no logos, no labels, no brand names, no watermark anywhere.
